headline: Harmonized multiomic resources make heterogeneous public omics data jointly analysable
label: Integrated Multiomics Data Resources
summary: Reproducible pipelines and curated resources now link RNA, ATAC, proteomic and genetic layers across heterogeneous public datasets.
synthesis: The dominant thread is infrastructure that makes heterogeneous public omics data analysable together. Reusable software addresses reproducibility directly: multiomeR offers a configurable R pipeline for QC, integration and annotation of single-nucleus Epi Multiome datasets, and hvantk provides a common data model extending Hail MatrixTable and AnnData for variant annotation and analysis. Curated databases integrate across studies: FITdb harmonizes 43 immune functional genetics screens, scTraitReg links GWAS signals to cell-type eRegulons across 111 single-cell multi-omic datasets, and scTHREAD links isoform, poly(A), junction and allelic evidence at cell resolution. TAPESTRY catalogs 45,430 tumor-enriched splice junctions across 19 pediatric brain tumor histologies. What is newer is cross-layer linkage paired with statistical restraint: rpMeta combines RNA-seq and proteomics by meta-analysis, and in the TOF meta-analysis only endothelial ciliary module M1 passed permutation testing, presented as hypothesis-generating.
